title: Rapt
summary: RAPT, participle passive [from rap.] Transported; ravished. RAPT, verb transitive To transport or ravish. [Not legitimate or in use.] RAPT, noun 1. An ecstasy; a trance. 2. Rapidity. [Not in use.]
